mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth drops by > 4pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate by more than 50 basis points in a month signals an abrupt shift to monetary tightening that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp M/M but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series is rising and the unemployment rate is falling, it signals a virtuous cycle of strengthening demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rising and UNRATE falling, but SPX 60-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth is accelerating and the unemployment rate is low, it signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth accelerating and UNRATE < 5%, but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising and inflation is already high, it signals a monetary policy overshoot that will drive a recession and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 3%, but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is decelerating and consumer spending is falling, it signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth decelerating and RSAFS falling, but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.
